{{Quote|These marks are too easy. Not enough credits.|A [[Unidentified Balnab bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], about several targets, including Mindbend|<ref name="Revenge" />}}
'''Nim Mindbend''' was a [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] criminal who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Revenge" /> Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]] dates the events of "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]" to during the third [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the start of the Clone Wars to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the events of "Revenge" must take place around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> they were wanted [[Death/Legends|dead]] for 120,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for kidnapping, theft, and murder. Among other targets, Mindbend was discussed as a bounty by several [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who assembled in the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley Cantina]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the bounty hunters considered Mindbend's bounty as too low and instead caught interest on another target&mdash;the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]].<ref name="Revenge" />

==Behind the scenes==
An image of Mindbend first appeared in "[[Bounty (episode)|Bounty]],"<ref name="Bounty">{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}}</ref> the twentieth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[March 2]], [[2012]].<ref name="Explore: Bounty">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep420|text="Bounty" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
